headCommit.message:
chore: merge current main into observability fixes

Retain fresh Organization sharing and approval checks outside the existing application policy memo. Preserve both sides' read-path regressions and regenerate route manifests with the canonical generator.

Includes the PostgreSQL-verified task-run visibility fix. Formal CI, Native budgets, and production trace acceptance remain to be verified.

Related to #1512.
